question: What is the total number of delivered orders?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered';

question: What are the top 5 product categories by total sales revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the total revenue generated from all delivered orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered';

question: How many distinct customers have placed an order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM orders;

question: Which 5 cities have the highest number of customers?
gold_sql: SELECT customer_city, COUNT(customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY customer_city ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What are the top 5 customer states by total order count?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the average order value for delivered orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.order_id);

question: What is the distribution of orders by order status?
gold_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY count DESC;

question: What is the breakdown of order payments by payment type?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS total_value FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY total_value DESC;

question: What is the average review score across all reviews?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM order_reviews;

question: How many reviews were given for each review score from 1 to 5?
gold_sql: SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS count FROM order_reviews GROUP BY review_score ORDER BY review_score ASC;

question: What are the top 5 sellers by total sales revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT s.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the average freight value paid per order item?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(freight_value), 2) AS avg_freight FROM order_items;

question: Show monthly order count for delivered orders in 2017.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month ASC;

question: Show monthly revenue from delivered orders in 2017.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_month, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS monthly_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month ASC;

question: Which product category has the highest average product price?
gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY category ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average number of items per order?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(item_count), 2) AS avg_items_per_order FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id);

question: Which 5 sellers have the highest number of sold items?
gold_sql: SELECT seller_id, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY items_sold DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the total freight cost spent on delivered orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2) AS total_freight FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered';

question: Which payment type has the highest average payment installments?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(payment_installments), 2) AS avg_installments FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY avg_installments DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average review score for delivered orders by customer state top 5?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many unique products have been ordered at least once?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_products_ordered FROM order_items;

question: List the top 3 states by total seller count?
gold_sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(seller_id) AS seller_count FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 3;

question: What is the minimum, maximum, and average price of products sold?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(price) AS min_price, MAX(price) AS max_price, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM order_items;

question: How many orders have more than 1 item?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS multi_item_orders FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);

question: What is the total payment value collected across all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS total_payments FROM order_payments;

question: How many orders were canceled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled';

question: Which 5 cities have the highest number of sellers?
gold_sql: SELECT seller_city, COUNT(seller_id) AS seller_count FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_city ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What are the top 3 product categories by number of items sold?
gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, COUNT(*) AS items_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY category ORDER BY items_sold DESC LIMIT 3;

question: What is the average weight in grams of products by category for the top 5 categories?
gold_sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, ROUND(AVG(p.product_weight_g), 2) AS avg_weight_g FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE p.product_weight_g IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY avg_weight_g DESC LIMIT 5;
